source_file: Tracking Data Methods/AAR Example SAS Code.sas
notes: CDC EPHT age-adjusted rate calculation: SORT + PROC MEANS sum on count and population data, MERGE by county/state/age/year, 2000 standard population age weights, crude rate (n_count/n_pop*10000) and weighted rate, final PROC MEANS sum producing the county/state/year AAR. STEP 1 OLEDB import replaced by structurally faithful Count_Data + Population_Data in autoexec (5-yr age bands 1-18, 2 counties, 2 years); &events macro defined. STEPs 2-7 unchanged from source.
